title: Songwriter Open Mic @ bmc brewing
event_description: Acoustic songwriter open mic night featuring both original songs and covers. This intimate gathering welcomes up to two performers at a time in an acoustic-only format. Hosted by Michael J. Brennan in the unique acoustics of bmc brewing.
event_time_plain: Sign up at 1:30 PM - Music 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM
backline: Acoustic instruments only - no drums or backing tracks
event_venue_information:
About bmc brewing

bmc brewing (Bite My Cookies Brewing Company) is a family-owned nanobrewery located in the heart of The Plant complex in Pittsboro. The brewery opened in 2021 and serves Chatham County with 18 taps of beer brewed on-site using locally sourced ingredients. The taproom features indoor and outdoor seating and hosts regular music events including open mics and acoustic jam sessions.

Music and Community Events

Beyond the monthly songwriter open mic the venue hosts acoustic jam sessions twice monthly on Tuesdays and Thursdays. The brewery is part of the Chatham Beverage District at The Plant which also includes Starrlight Mead Fair Game Beverage Company Chatham Cider Works and other local businesses. Regular events include Whiskey Wednesdays Tequila Tuesdays game nights and live music performances.

The Venue

The building houses the taproom brewery and Smelt Art Gallery creating a unique atmosphere for music and community gathering. bmc brewing prioritizes sustainability using solar power and processing spent grains into flour for their signature cookies. The brewery supports the local community through partnerships with non-profits and focuses on creating a welcoming family-friendly environment.

title: Bluegrass Jam Circle @ Bynum Front Porch
event_description: Open circle bluegrass jam session welcoming musicians of all skill levels and ages. This free community gathering has been a tradition since the early 2000s bringing together pickers and singers in the historic Bynum General Store. Acoustic instruments only.
backline: Acoustic instruments only - bring your instrument or voice
event_venue_information:
About Bynum Front Porch

Bynum Front Porch is a nonprofit organization that leases the historic Bynum General Store built in 1934. The organization creates family-friendly events and programs that celebrate the community's rich history and bright future. Located in the former cotton mill village of Bynum along the Haw River the venue has become a premier destination for traditional music and storytelling in North Carolina.

Music Programs and Events

In addition to the twice-monthly bluegrass jam circle Bynum Front Porch hosts the Friday Night Music Series from May through August featuring diverse bands spanning gospel folk blues rockabilly and bluegrass. The venue is also home to Mill Town Yarns a performance series recognized by the NC Storytellers Guild as one of the state's premier storytelling hubs. The 2025-26 season features both professional and local performers.

Community and History

Bynum was originally a cotton mill village set along the banks of the Haw River with the first mill built around 1872. The mill closed in 1983 but the community spirit remains strong. Bynum Front Porch has given over $30000 in grants to Chatham County students and continues to serve as a gathering place for the community offering the facility for birthday parties baby showers wedding receptions and other celebrations.
